ValidationRule.description: When Span Type is Days, internal numeric duration must be 1–90 (normally set from the Span Duration dropdown).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Span_Type__c, "Days"), NOT(ISBLANK(Span_Duration__c)), OR( Span_Duration__c < 1, Span_Duration__c > 90 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Days, choose a duration from 1 to 90.
